name: polaris-social
description: Social platform read & write: search, trending lists, feeds, and full-text reading on Zhihu, X, Weibo, and Xiaohongshu (zero-token API interception first), plus multi-platform posting and engagement; reads and writes share per-platform rate limits and risk circuit breakers.

interface.shortDescription: Read Zhihu, X, Weibo, and Xiaohongshu content and post across platforms, with shared rate limits.
interface.longDescription:
The official Polaris social platform plugin. Read: social_search / social_hot / social_feed / social_read reuse your signed-in Chrome and, guided by per-site recipes, intercept page XHR JSON first (zero tokens); reading and posting share the same per-platform rate limits and risk circuit breakers. Write: publish, delete, comment, like, and send direct messages on Twitter/X, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat Official Accounts, Instagram, Facebook, and more, and read each platform's compliance guidelines via get_platform_skill.

Requires: Python ≥3.14, Chrome.
defaultPrompt: 搜索知乎上关于 AI Agent 的讨论并总结。
看看 X 上 OpenAI 最近发了什么。
